methodology.percentile: Median averages middle pair; p95 nearest rank ceil(0.95*n)-1 in zero-indexed sorted samples.
methodology.rest: Full bloom; production cluster transforms and shared production cage pins. Torenia uses its render model; independent sensitive-stigma animation is outside this solver.
methodology.sequence: Fresh solver and CPU displacement texture per species/device; sequential cases; no reset between warmup and measured calls. CPU transfer follows each solver call.
methodology.solverTimed: Only PetalDynamics.step(1/60, force), including integration, constraints, contacts and cage/rest normals.
methodology.texturePreparationTimed: Only CageDeformation.update(inverses), CPU displacement/normal packing plus needsUpdate; no WebGL context, upload, draw or WebGPU work.
methodology.initialization: Separate single construction observations, not warmed medians. Cage preparation is simulation-patch preparation, not rendered shell/organ/leaf tessellation. No tissue-atlas or HDR bake timing is recorded.
methodology.excluded: Moving carrier/articulation preparation, per-frame rest updates, independent organ animations, geometry tessellation, instance updates, tissue/HDR bakes, PMREM, WebGL/WebGPU upload/draw, DOM/browser cadence.
methodology.limits: Both budgets run on this desktop CPU; no physical-phone/FPS claim, CPU affinity or power-mode isolation. Other desktop applications may be active.
